sceneDescription: On a bright supermarket checkout belt, a classic wire shopping basket contains a gold-plated smart speaker (resembling Alexa), nestled among mundane groceries like bananas, a loaf of bread, and a carton of milk. Tucked beside the speaker is a fancy Kate Spade purse, and a Walmart reusable bag peeks from underneath. Small, incidental Best Buy and Target stickers are subtly attached to the banana and milk carton. The absurdity comes from seeing a luxury smart device and designer purse treated as groceries, all jumbled together on an everyday checkout belt.
